meta.title: Submitting without a flow when approval is configured is refused

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
The buyer sends the award proposal call, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “Approval Flow not found”, and never with a server error.
